# Ordinary number scanning

The fixed MathJax 3.2.2 TeX digits option is `^(?:[0-9]+(?:\{,\}[0-9]{3})*(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)`. It matches ASCII digits and consumes the original source length. Braces are removed only from numeric token text. A failed dot/comma match is a font-aware `mo` through ParseMethods.digit, without Other's fixStretchy registration. Non-ASCII Nd characters use each supported pinned range's Kind and optional Variant, one codepoint at a time. The creating parser's token factory precedes the range override; no generic Unicode, font, vector, renderer or macro joining policy changes.

`generate_ordinary_number.cjs NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY` uses the three hash-pinned D2 v0.8.1 assets, 80 public inputs and 15 registered/parser observations. It delegates the actual digit/Other methods; plain/passive results must agree. Raw creation/Push identities, complete attribute layers, maps and cursors are retained in regeneration output. The committed whole-output fixture is derived from untouched primary observations, not this Go implementation.

All 92 supported outputs have primary SVGs. Of their complete ordered explicit/own trees, 88 are strict. Four public vector/prime cases retain one exactly named inherited token-property boundary each: an extra arrow `texClass:0`, or an omitted prime `pseudoscript:false`. The fixture retains the original primary tree, while the boundary file binds the complete primary and accepted token nodes, exact primary/baseline paths, and the raw accepted-record digest. Tests reject other property, attribute, child or order changes. These are metadata qualifications, not whole-output equality claims.

The other three inputs contain U+1FBF1, outside the pinned range table. The primary conversions throw TypeError before any output; their original error records are retained. Tests separately preserve complete accepted Go SVG/tree controls for those inputs. No successful primary result, new Go error or panic is invented. Across the original plain/passive passes these were six caught conversion errors, not Node process crashes.

Twelve actual handler controls bind source consumption, UTF16/byte conversion, remaining text, unchanged font/state/counters, same created/Push token identity and complete Push-boundary tokens. Go's existing deferred ambient-font lowering is applied at its corresponding append boundary. Its exact local token/font marker sets are asserted before comparison, not broadly stripped from arbitrary trees. The bold Osmanya record explicitly proves initial mi/bold and same-node mi/normal after the range override. The two parser-continuation observations remain complete-output controls; the existing registered-macro source reset difference belongs to D089.

The inherited 120 D078 primary records and all three immediate-script lookahead sites are untouched. Their twenty obsolete scanner qualifications are removed after every whole SVG and complete map matches the unchanged primary. All 120 SVGs now match; four exact inherited prime metadata bounds remain, while 116 complete trees are primary. Existing handler/cursor/whitespace tests remain active. Source and raw evidence preserve the accepted parent `bca7909b2de5fc00d0057b24092c31ebd15ac7b6` and all original observations.
